source.check: returned unopposed: two nominations (Wm. John Johnston, J.P., and Samuel Carson; Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1924, p. 5), but 'only one contest, in Ballykeel' went to the poll (Belfast News-Letter, 15 May 1924, p. 12), and at the first meeting (10 June 1924) Samuel Carson was co-opted an additional member while only Breda had a member co-opted for a division (Belfast News-Letter, 11 June 1924, p. 5), so Carson withdrew and Johnston was returned

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Hillsborough rural district. Only one division, Ballykeel, was contested at the poll of Thursday 5 June 1924; the result was declared on 6 June (Belfast News-Letter and Irish News, 7 June 1924). The uncontested divisions are named in the nominations list (Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1924, p. 5) and the withdrawals report (15 May 1924, p. 12) ('meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026'). No nomination was made for Breda, where Fred Bleakley was co-opted at the first meeting on 10 June 1924; a co-option is not an election, so Breda has no contest. The council also co-opted three additional members (J. R. Morrow, Samuel Carson, W. J. M'Gifford). The withdrawal itself is not printed; Johnston's return follows from the three reports cited. Returned unopposed.
